limitations: Public source content was read back via GitHub for Grow1–6; their Sites controller blobs match exactly.
Absence is verified in the checked test and main trees, not an exhaustive scan of every possible branch or fork.
Sites commit IDs are provenance, not a claim those commit objects exist on public GitHub.
Grow3 README has a GitHub-specific historical source-reference note; existing public entry is retained, not overwritten by the Sites variant.
Historical synthetic counts and gameplay statistics are not merged with the current evaluation.
